environment.description: Quarkus serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-http extension. PostgreSQL RDS instance (db.t3.medium) with database user 'inventory_app' having full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema. gRPC endpoint exposed through API Gateway HTTP API with no request validation. Security group allows Lambda to reach RDS on port 5432. No WAF or input filtering configured.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO inventory_app
config.network: Lambda in VPC with RDS security group ingress on 5432
config.api_gateway: HTTP API with gRPC-Web proxy, no request validation
